summary: Mineral County, MT lookout site on the Lolo NF: 1933 crow's nest, then a 50-foot pole L-4 tower by 1941; destroyed in the 1970s per firelookout.com; FFLA lists it gone.

facts.design: Crow's nest (1933), then a 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (1941)
facts.status_note: firelookout.com says the tower was destroyed in the 1970s, with no exact year; the FFLA Montana list marks it gone
facts.agency: Lolo National Forest (as named on firelookout.com)

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, listed for 1941; the page does not say what became of the crow's nest

evidence.supports: site lies on the Lolo National Forest
about 10 miles northwest of St. Regis
coordinates 47.40738, -115.23447; listed as Tower type, Gone status
